landing.title: Simplify payroll and invoicing in one place
landing.subtitle: An all-in-one tool to automate payslips, legal filings, and client invoices — built for freelancers and small businesses alike.

features.title: Features
features.heading: Payroll management that seems to come from the future
features.description: Powerful and intuitive tools to automate payroll, simplify administrative procedures, and save precious time. Designed for modern SMEs. Already adopted by dozens of companies.

access.title: Share HR access
access.description: Whether you're 2 or 200, keep everyone aligned thanks to shared access and well-defined roles.

payslips.title: Generate payslips instantly
payslips.description: Create and download pay slips with one click, always up to date with legislation.

reports.title: Track your obligations with reports
reports.description: Clear dashboards, schedules, exportable: manage URSSAF, DSN and other declarations without stress.

employees.title: Simplify your employees' lives
employees.description: A dedicated space to consult pay slips, request absences, and centralize all their documents.

documents.title: Manage all your HR documents
documents.description: Contracts, bank details, supporting documents, attachments: everything is stored securely and classified automatically.

support.title: A team that supports you
support.description: Our experts are available 7 days a week to answer your questions, train you or help you when you need it.
